## Aug 10 Results: The Numbers Don't Lie

Let's break down yesterday's performance. We went 6-4 across a 10-game slate, posting a 60.0% win rate. Not elite, but solidly profitable. The model hit on 6 of 10 predictions, with our highest-confidence picks showing mixed results.

## Breaking Down the Performance

The data reveals an interesting pattern: our 63% confidence picks went 3-3, a coin flip result. Meanwhile, our lower-confidence plays (50-62% range) hit at a better clip. The Twins pick at 50% confidence? Hit. Sometimes the tightest games are the easiest to read.

## Key Takeaways from Aug 10

Our biggest misses came in close games: Sox-Jays, Mets-Braves, and Cardinals-Phillies. The Brewers-Padres upset at 63% confidence stings the most from a value perspective. But look at the wins: Rangers, Rays, Astros, and Dodgers all delivered as expected. The Diamondbacks crushing the Rockies at 63% was textbook.

## Aug 11 Preview: Tomorrow's Top Pick

The model is targeting the Guardians-Tigers matchup. Drew Anderson takes the mound for Detroit against Cleveland's Tanner Bibee. The numbers favor the home team at 58% confidence—not our highest conviction play, but the pitching matchup and home field advantage create value.
